### 2. json-unit 3.x API migration (varargs options)
json-unit 3.2.7 removed the `withOptions(Options)` overload, keeping only varargs `withOptions(Option, Option...)` (verified via `javap` on the actual 3.2.7 jar). I converted every call across 13 `src/main/scala` contract files:

Added a custom `implicit val instantReads: Reads[Instant]` that parses via `Instant.parse`:

implicit val instantReads: Reads[Instant] = {
  case JsNumber(value) => JsSuccess(Instant.ofEpochMilli(value.toLong))
  case JsString(value) => JsSuccess(Instant.parse(value))
  case _ => JsError()

+import java.time.Instant
+import play.api.libs.json._
+case class Meta(name: String, internalDate: Instant)
+object Repro {
+  implicit val instantReads: Reads[Instant] = {
+    case JsNumber(value) => JsSuccess(Instant.ofEpochMilli(value.toLong))
+    case JsString(value) => JsSuccess(Instant.parse(value))
+    case _ => JsError()
+  }
+  implicit val metaReads: Reads[Meta] = Json.reads[Meta]
+  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = {
+    // valid
+    val ok = metaReads.reads(Json.parse("""{"name":"x","internalDate":"2018-12-14T09:41:51+00:00"}""")).get
+    println("VALID -> " + ok.internalDate)
+    // invalid date
+    try {
+      val r = metaReads.reads(Json.parse("""{"name":"x","internalDate":"2018-12-14"}"""))
+      println("no throw during reads, result=" + r + " ; calling get")
+      r.get
+      println("BUG: no exception")
+    } catch {
+      case e: Throwable => println("INVALID -> " + e.getClass.getName)
+    }
+    // missing/other field invalid (name missing) should be NoSuchElement at get
+    try {
+      metaReads.reads(Json.parse("""{"internalDate":"2018-12-14T09:41:51+00:00"}""")).get
+    } catch {
+      case e: Throwable => println("MISSING FIELD -> " + e.getClass.getName)
+    }
+  }
+}
